## Description

"Patient withdrew consent" action during recording: capture stops immediately (CONSENT_REVOKED), audio after the revocation time is discarded client- and server-side, pending AI jobs are cancelled or limited to pre-revocation audio per policy, a receipt is recorded, and the doctor continues manually.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** After revocation no further chunks are accepted for that session (server rejects).
- [ ] **AC2.** Audio after the revocation timestamp is deleted and the deletion is recorded.
- [ ] **AC3.** Pending jobs re-check consent and do not process revoked ranges (worker test).
- [ ] **AC4.** UI shows "Recording stopped at {t}. Audio after withdrawal was discarded." and a "Continue manually" action.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
